import csv,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('results/identity_quality_v2')
i=json.loads((root/'summary.json').read_text())
grid=list(csv.DictReader(Path('results/summary/grid_summary.csv').open()))
print('Stored historical n=%s results; one shared T_ref for each returned configuration' % i['n'])
print('Reference: %s configurations, valid counts=%s; minimum median = %.6f s' %
      (len(grid), sorted({int(r['valid_runs']) for r in grid}), i['reference_min_s']))
print('Algorithm   Seed     Return     Gap_ref(%)   Separate_confirm(s)  Calls   Full_MONO(s)')
for r in csv.DictReader((root/'search_choices.csv').open()):
    if r['algorithm'] in ('grid','random','greedy'):
        print('%-10s %7s  s%3s/%s  %10.2f %21.6f  %2s+%s %14.2f' %
          (r['algorithm'],r['seed'],r['s'],r['opt'],float(r['gap_ref_pct']),
           float(r['separate_confirmation_s']),r['search_process_runs'],r['confirmation_process_runs'],
           float(r['total_driver_monotonic_s'])))
s=json.loads(Path('results/raw_aa_summary_v3/summary.json').read_text())
print('')
tasks=s['tasks']
print('New RAW A/A: %s process starts, %s valid samples, %s tasks not started.' %
      (sum(r['actual_process_starts'] for r in tasks),
       sum(r['valid_measurements'] for r in tasks),
       sum(r['actual_process_starts']==0 for r in tasks)))
print('Clock healthy=%s; formal admission=%s; method evidence ready=%s' %
      (s['raw_aa']['clock_healthy'],s['raw_aa']['formal_admission'],
       s['raw_aa']['formal_method_evidence_ready']))

import json,shlex,textwrap
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('evidence/reproduction/goal2')
b=json.loads((root/'goal2-clean-independent-cold-build.stdout.txt').read_text())
print('Clean cold builds of the final MONOTONIC target (no performance score)')
for r in b['builds']:
    print('%s: %-30s cached=%s rc=%s binary=%s' %
        (r['opt'],' '.join(r['flags']),r['cached'],r['compile']['returncode'],r['binary_sha256'][:16]))
print('Source SHA256: '+b['builds'][0]['source_sha256'])
c=json.loads((root/'clean_regression_r1.json').read_text())
print('Independent clean tests: %s, %s tests, %s skipped; Python syntax: %s, %s files.' %
      (c['test_execution']['state'],c['test_execution']['tests'],c['test_execution']['skipped'],
       c['syntax_execution']['state'],c['syntax_execution']['count']))
f=json.loads((root/'clean-fresh-n4096-check.json').read_text())
print('')
cfg=f['measurement']['config']
print('Stored fresh attempt: s%s/%s, n4096 calls=%s; role=%s' %
      (cfg['s'],cfg['opt'],f['resource']['n4096_calls'],f['role']))
# Only shorten checkout prefixes for display; the complete argv remains in the input JSON.
checkout=Path.cwd()/'.cache/clean-goal2'
display=[arg.replace(str(checkout)+'/', '').replace(str(Path.cwd().parent)+'/', '')
         for arg in f['command']]
print('Recorded command (checkout prefixes shortened):')
for line in textwrap.wrap(shlex.join(display),width=125):print('  '+line)
print('Driver return code: %s; live-guard reason: %s' % (f['resource']['returncode'],f['resource']['reason']))
print('Complete target result: %s; charged resource = %.9f s' % (f['complete'],f['resource']['resource_s']))
print('No benchmark result or clock admission is inferred from this interrupted attempt.')
